_note: Per-sheet scores for the 15 released sheets under the rules of 23 November 2026 (see scoring/score.py), produced by running that scorer on scoring/predictions/<system>/: ten object classes, objects matched on their real shapes ("found" rule), the window rule, the review ledger in annotation_review.json, and the area rule that merges stairs and elevators with the area they touch. object_tp / object_fp / object_fn pool the classes the system supports and include outside_vocabulary_fp. classes gives [tp, fp, fn] per class. wall_pixel and area_pixel are [pixels in both, delivered only, annotation only] at short side 5000; area_instance is [tp, fp, fn]. The figures under "systems" are pooled over the 15 sheets, not averaged, and keep six decimals so that they round correctly to three. Corpus figures are pooled over all 312 sheets and are not the mean of these.
